verdict:
WATCH — 'covered, honestly-marked, priced approximately fairly, with no dated catalyst' (blue PARTIALLY OVERTURNED red, 8/10, on the CORRECTED record after the first court's kill was vacated as a proxy-truncation artifact).

THE RE-COURT ANSWERED THE QUESTION THE FIRST ONE DUCKED, and the answer is BOTH-AND rather than either-or. The honest-marker case HELD: the Incentive Fee Cap subtracts unrealized losses and is binding at $0, PIK is falling to 13.0% of GAAP NII (lowest in the mid tier while NMFC's 41.8% and FSK's 34.9% rise), the dividend cut 0.38->0.31 RESTORED coverage to ~126%, and MFIC marks BELOW co-lender FSK on Galaxy Universal (94.8 vs 97.3) having moved its own mark DOWN 3.3 points. Blue calls the book honestly marked and I accept it.

BUT THE 54.9-CENT TENSION RESOLVED AGAINST MFIC IN A SPECIFIC AND NAMEABLE WAY — blue's §7, which it calls red's best finding: 'Affiliated cost +20.1%, reclassification drains the non-accrual stat... The 4.6%-at-cost gate is measured on a LEAKING POPULATION.' There is a RESTRUCTURING PIPELINE THAT LAUNDERS THE NON-ACCRUAL STATISTIC. That is exactly the Amplity manoeuvre I flagged — off non-accrual, reclassified to AFFILIATED, $11.5M of new term loans attached — generalised into a mechanism. So MFIC's non-accruals are BOTH the least written down in the cohort (54.9c vs TCPC 19.4c) AND measured on a denominator that is being drained. The 4.6% figure is technically filed and materially soft.

WHAT ELSE MOVED: red's cushion kill is an ARTIFACT — 'MFIC is delevering roughly as fast as it is losing, and with the buyback spent it delevers faster', so the 8.4% covenant clock does not tick the way red modelled. Blue substituted the right tripwire: watch ASSET COVERAGE >=165%, not net leverage <=1.45x, because that is the variable that actually moved. Red's NII-decay leg SPLIT: the absolute decline is real ($36.4M -> $32.8M) but the yield leg (9.2% -> 8.1%) is REDUCED to PLAUSIBLE — MFIC is 100% floating and a 110bp decline across a year of Fed cuts needs a SOFR decomposition nobody ran (FRED 403'd this session). Unattributed, that is an INDEX MOVE PRESENTED AS ISSUER DECAY.

WHY WATCH AND NOT A POSITION: zero economic return on book TTM, no dated catalyst, and covered paper (8 analysts, Hold, $10.50 target — the orphan carve-out correctly disclaimed). The TCPC ruling binds and blue says so explicitly: NO LEVERED BDC WITHOUT A DATED CATALYST. A ~27% discount on a fairly-priced book is not compensation for an undated wait.

NON-ACCRUAL POPULATION INTEGRITY: the 4.6%-at-cost figure is measured on a LEAKING population — affiliated cost +20.1% as restructurings move credits OFF non-accrual and INTO the affiliated bucket (the Amplity manoeuvre). Any future non-accrual gate must be read alongside the affiliated-cost delta, or it is measuring a drained denominator.

OPEN AND UNRESOLVED: the SOFR decomposition on the 9.2%->8.1% yield decline (FRED 403'd) — until run, an index move is being read as issuer decay; and the return-of-capital characterisation.

METRIC_INVALIDATION_20260818: *** METRIC INVALIDATED 2026-08-18 (OBDC blue bench) — READ BEFORE USING ANY 'IMPLIED MARK ON NON-ACCRUALS' FIGURE IN THIS RECORD. *** The cohort ladder I built and used all session — TCPC 19.4c / OTF 22.8c / OBDC 29.5c / PNNT 31.1c / FSK 47.9c / WHF 50.4c / MFIC 55.1c — DOES NOT MEASURE MARKING DISCIPLINE. Implied mark = non-accrual FV% / cost% is dominated by CONCENTRATION AND TIMING: it tells you WHEN a manager's worst credit blew up, not how honestly it marks. Proof: 79% of OBDC's entire Q2 unrealized loss is ONE second lien (Loparex, $130.6M marked 63c -> 5c, independently confirmed via PitchBook). Ex-that-single-name OBDC computes at 38.7c rather than 29.5c. A manager whose big blow-up is RECENT looks harsh; one whose blow-up was years ago and is already written to zero looks soft — with identical discipline. THE LADDER MUST BE RECOMPUTED EX-LARGEST-NAME BEFORE IT IS EVER USED TO ORDER MANAGERS AGAIN, and until then no verdict may rest on it. Note the ordering may survive — ex-Loparex OBDC still marks harsher than FSK, WHF and MFIC as published — but that is unproven for the others because only OBDC has been decomposed. Affected: every classification below that cites the ladder, and the court contexts for MFIC, OTF and OBDC.
